marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 25 knots increasing to southeast 30 late this
afternoon then diminishing to east 15 near noon Wednesday. Wind backing to north
15 Wednesday afternoon. Scattered flurries changing to snow overnight. Visibility 1
mile or less in snow. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 early this evening and to
2 to 3 after midnight. Seas subsiding to 1 to 2 Wednesday
afternoon.<br/>
